Relapse fraction, by episodes and by acquisitions

Source: R/metrics.R
relapse_fraction.Rd

Relapses as a share of a run's blood-stage cases, in two readings, both counted per clone onset (a row of classify_cases(), so a bite that delivers two genotypes counts twice):

Usage

relapse_fraction(events, exclude_masked = FALSE)

Arguments

events

an events table from load_events(), or a run (a vivax_run or its directory).

exclude_masked

if TRUE, leave out the masked relapses.

Value

a one-row data.table: n_relapse, n_new_infection (imported and local reinfection), n_recrudescence, relapse_frac_episodes and relapse_frac_acquisitions, each fraction NA when its denominator is 0 (a run with no case).

Details

  • relapse_frac_episodes – relapses over every case: imported, local reinfection, relapse and recrudescence.

  • relapse_frac_acquisitions – relapses over the acquisitions: imported, local reinfection and relapse. A recrudescence is a new clinical episode but not a newly acquired parasite (its genotype was already in the host), so it is left out. This is the fraction the calibration in section 13 of the model description compares with published studies.

The two are equal when a run has no recrudescence, as at the default P_RECRUD_GIVEN_FAIL = 0. Both count each host's first case, which is not a recurrence; recurrences() gives the recurrences alone.

Masked relapses, into a patent clone of their own lineage (see classify_cases()), are counted unless exclude_masked = TRUE leaves them out of the numerator and both denominators, as a study that sees only the relapses that bring a new clone would. NU_HYPNOZOITE_BATCH was fitted with every relapse counted (0.63 at its shipped value of 3, inside the calibration target), and leaving the masked relapses out gives 0.37, below it (section 13 of the model description).

See also

classify_cases(), summarise_run()

Examples

relapse_fraction(example_run())
#>    n_relapse n_new_infection n_recrudescence relapse_frac_episodes
#>        <int>           <int>           <int>                 <num>
#> 1:       158             136               5             0.5284281
#>    relapse_frac_acquisitions
#>                        <num>
#> 1:                  0.537415
